pages.text: Separate deuterium from water, breed tritium, and press both into $(item)Fusion Fuel Pellets$() for the $(l:multiblocks/fusion_reactor)Fusion Reactor$(). The $(item)Ore Purifier$() cleans washed ore with oxygen and sometimes gives a by-product.
The Fusion Reactor burns fuel pellets for a lot of power and breeds some of its tritium back.
